title: Multispecies Elasmobranch Aggregation in the Subtropical Southwest Atlantic Ocean
content:
ABSTRACT

Here, we describe the opportunistic sighting of a multispecies aggregation of 70 hammerhead sharks (Sphyrna lewini), 30 silky sharks (Carcharhinus falciformis) and 50 cownose rays (Rhinoptera sp.) co-occurring at the same location in the Alcatrazes MPA, Brazil, in the Southwestern Atlantic Ocean.
